summary: AstraZeneca PLC filed a Form 6-K (report of foreign issuer) announcing FDA approval of Datroway for 1L triple-negative breast cancer. This is a product approval announcement, not a special situation. The filing discusses clinical trial results, regulatory approval, and commercial implications, but does not involve M&A, activist campaigns, restructurings, or other special-situation categories. The registrant is a foreign private issuer reporting routine regulatory and business developments. No deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes are present.
